resources.string: If you reinstall HowYouDoin on this phone, your logins come back from your Google backup and you won't have to log in to each network again. The backup is end-to-end encrypted with your screen lock; nothing is sent to us.\n\nWhatsApp and Signal always need linking again.

Your logins are only saved if the phone's backup is on:

1. Open Settings → Google → Backup (on Samsung: Accounts and backup → Back up data).
2. Turn on "Backup by Google One" and choose your Google account.
3. Keep a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password): backups are encrypted with it.

If it's already on, you're all set. The phone backs up on its own, usually overnight while charging.
Your phone's backup has the logins you used before. Reconnect them so you don't have to log in again?
